note: every route the clone serves (src/data/routes.txt = 1,898 + '/menu/', which the clone serves but the source route list omits), mapped exactly once. Mapping = the clone's own router (react-router matchRoutes over the route tables in src/routes.jsx -> src/pages/<group>/routes.jsx), then page component -> template by semantic purpose (ToolsArticle splits: /research-maturity-assessment/ -> T21 editorial article, /resources/dovetail-vs-* -> T22 comparison article). Unknown slugs under /blog/, /changelog/, /<hub>/, /customers/, /events/ render their template with a slug-derived title (they never reach the 404); only paths no table matches fall back to T38.
